'''Lloyd Zisla Turning to the Dark Side Pays Off''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Lloyd Zisla]]
* '''Published:''' April 1997 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Hoth]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Death Star: Central Core]]
* '''Strategy:''' Turning to the Dark Side Pays Off
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PHoth Turning to the Dark Side Pays Off.txt |Download]]
